name: PR-3
prompt: A close-up of a white fibreglass boat hull with WHITE vinyl registration lettering applied to it, reading exactly "WN 1234 AB" - the lettering is almost invisible against the white gelcoat, readable only by the faint shadow at its edges. The characters are perfectly upright block capitals with clear spaces between the groups. Shot square on in overcast daylight. Casual smartphone snapshot, not a professional photograph. Flat overcast daylight, no golden hour. Slightly off-level handheld framing, visible sensor noise, natural muted colour, no HDR, no glow. Do not render: human faces, brand logos, any text except the quoted lettering, golden-hour light, glossy oversaturated colour, HDR halos, studio lighting, watermark.
